title: Homochirality: Why Nature Never Makes Mirror Molecules
summary: Steve Mould explains homochirality: why biological molecules like sugars and amino acids come in only one handedness. He covers ideas about how this asymmetry might have arisen, touching on meteorite samples and RNA.
why: Cited as a clear, accessible explanation of why life uses only one version of chiral molecules.

quote.text: Here is a video talking about molecular chirality and how nature really only produces one version of molecules
